sources.title: donut-base-finetuned-docvqa: Image-to-Text model — overview, use cases ...
sources.snippet: Overview donut-base-finetuned-docvqa is a document visual question answering model maintained by naver-clova-ix that answers questions about document images without requiring OCR preprocessing. The model combines a Swin Transformer vision encoder with a BART text decoder, encoding document images into embeddings that the decoder then uses to generate answers autoregressively.
